title: Untrack python/.coverage binary artifact (add to gitignore)
description: Repo hygiene noticed during kpv0.8 verification: python/.coverage is a TRACKED binary coverage-data file that changes on every local pytest --cov run (it showed as modified immediately after running the documented probe). Coverage artifacts are machine-local state and should not be versioned: add '.coverage' to python/.gitignore (or root .gitignore) and git rm --cached python/.coverage. Needs Mark's explicit ok since it removes a tracked file. No functional impact.
